CustomField.description: Consulted by the formTemplate LWC only when Stage_Indicator_Type__c is vertical and Stages_Mode__c is false: makes the vertical rail's steps clickable so respondents can jump between pages, reusing the Stages Mode navigation path including Form_Submission_Stage__c writes. Stages Mode is inherently non-linear and ignores this flag.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Let respondents jump between pages by clicking the vertical stage indicator, without turning on Stages Mode. Requires Stage Indicator Type to be vertical; Stages Mode already allows free navigation, so this setting only matters when Stages Mode is off.
CustomField.label: Non-Linear Navigation
